title: Åbent værksted i Labbet / drop in consultations at KUB Datalab
description:
Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

title: Python for absolutte nybegyndere del 1 (dansk), #summer(school)
description:
Dette kursus er en del af vores Python Sommerskole. Vi tilbyder Python-kurser hele ugen fra den 10.-14. august.
Du kan tilmelde dig ét kursus eller lige så mange, du har lyst til.

Python for absolutte nybegyndere del 1 & 2 er vores grundkurser. Når du har gennemført dem - eller hvis du allerede har tilsvarende erfaring med Python - kan du deltage på alle de øvrige Python-kurser i sommerskolen.

Du kan finde alt vores kursusmateriale her: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

Og tilmelde dig flere kurser her: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

Dette kursus er for studerende, der aldrig har programmeret før og gerne vil lære Python helt fra bunden.

Virker matematik, tal og kryptiske Python-scripts lidt intimiderende? Bare rolig! Vi gennemgår alle de grundlæggende begreber og byggesten trin for trin, så du kan komme godt i gang med Python - også selvom du aldrig har skrevet kode før.

Du bliver blandt andet introduceret til variabler og datatyper og lærer at skrive simple scripts, der arbejder med data gennem eksempelvis lister, løkker og betingelser. Når kurset er slut, vil du have en grundlæggende forståelse for, hvordan Python fungerer, og hvordan et computerprogram “tænker”. Det eneste, vi forventer af dig, er lysten til at lære. Vi glæder os til at se dig!

Kurset er opdelt i to dele. I første del ser vi på forskellige datatyper i Python og på, hvordan data gemmes og håndteres. Det fungerer som en introduktion til de mest grundlæggende elementer i Python-programmering.

I anden del bygger vi videre på det grundlæggende og sammensætter byggestenene til små scripts. Hvis du allerede har lidt erfaring med Python, kan du sagtens springe første del over. Ellers anbefaler vi, at du starter med del 1 og derefter fortsætter med del 2.

 

Praktisk information: Vi arbejder i Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, som kræver en mindre installation. Du kan dog også vælge at arbejde i Google Colab eller ERDA, som kun kræver henholdsvis en Google-konto eller en KU-konto. Du kan finde mere information og hjælp under “Install & Run Python” på kursussiden:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html
location_name: Library Lighthouse, zone 1, Library Lighthouse, zone 2

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 1, #summer(school)
description:
This course is part of our Python Summer School. We will offer courses throughout the week from August 10–14.
You can sign up for one course or as many as you like.

Python for Absolute Beginners part 1 & 2 are our core courses. After completing these (or if you already have Python knowledge equivalent to the course material), you can join all other Python courses in our Summer School.

You can find all of our course materials here: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html
location_name: Library Lighthouse, zone 1, Library Lighthouse, zone 2

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 2, #summer(school)
description:
This course is part of our Python Summer School. We will offer courses throughout the week from August 10–14.
You can sign up for one course or as many as you like.

Python for Absolute Beginners part 1 & 2 are our core courses. After completing these (or if you already have Python knowledge equivalent to the course material), you can join all other Python courses in our Summer School.

You can find all of our course materials here: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

You can sign up for one course or as many as you like.

Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 & 2 are our core courses. After completing these (or if you already have Python knowledge equivalent to the course material), you can join all other Python courses in our Summer School.

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

In this part, you will learn how to use list comprehensions to write cleaner and more efficient code, read from and write to files to store and retrieve data, and handle errors to make your programs more robust and reliable.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:

You can find all of our course materials here: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

In the Python for not quite Absolute Beginners courses, we expand on previous learning to write more structured and reliable programs. Before you attend these courses, make sure you have completed Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 and 2 or are familiar with its topics.

In this workshop, you gain knowledge about how to work with texts as data using the library pandas. We will use fairy tales as our example material and combine many of them into a single dataset. 

You will gain knowledge about: 

  • what a dataset of texts is in practice
  • how a DataFrame can be built from a folder of text files
  • how to combine multiple DataFrames using pd.concat
  • how to apply functions to text with .apply (for example, for text cleaning)
  • how to calculate simple metrics such as word count and TTR (type-token ratio)
  • how to compare authors using groupby (Split-Apply-Combine)
  • how to visualise simple patterns (for example, average word length by author)
  • how to save the data for further analysis

By the end of the workshop, you will have a structured dataset that you can use in Workshop 2 and in your own projects. 

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:

title: Python for not quite Absolute Beginners : text analysis with spaCy and prompts, #summer(school)
description:
This course is part of our Python Summer School. We will offer courses throughout the week from August 10–14.
You can sign up for one course or as many as you like.

Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 & 2 are our core courses. After completing these (or if you already have Python knowledge equivalent to the course material), you can join all other Python courses in our Summer School.

You can find all of our course materials here: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

In the Python for not quite Absolute Beginners courses, we expand on previous learning to write more structured and reliable programs. Before you attend these courses, make sure you have completed Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 and 2 or are familiar with its topics.

In this workshop, we shift focus from how to handle text data in pandas to doing text analysis and interpretation. We approach text analysis from two different perspectives. 

Part A – spaCy 

You will gain knowledge about: 

  • the Python library spaCy and what you can do with that (tokens, lemmas, part-of-speech tags, dependencies) 
  • how to process an entire text through a language model 
  • how to identify and count linguistic patterns (for example, adjectives describing characters, places, and buildings) 

Part B – Prompts in Text Analysis 

You will gain knowledge about: 

  • how you can use prompt engineering as a method in text analysis 
  • how to connect securely to the Mistral API (using environment variables for API keys rather than storing them in notebooks) 
  • the difference between user and system messages, as well as settings such as temperature and max tokens 
  • how to give the model specific analytical tasks (summaries, structured analysis, passage selection, sentiment analysis) 
  • how to save and critically evaluate the model’s responses (is the output grounded in the text and analytically useful?) 

By the end of the workshop, you will have been presented for methods to work with text analysis with pandas, with spaCy, and with LLM-based prompting, and you will have an idea about methods to apply in your future research. 

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:

In the Python for not quite Absolute Beginners courses, we expand on previous learning to write more structured and reliable programs. Before you attend these courses, make sure you have completed Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 and 2 or are familiar with its topics.

In this workshop, we shift focus from how to handle text data in pandas to doing text analysis and interpretation. We approach text analysis from two different perspectives. 

Part A – spaCy 

You will gain knowledge about: 

  • the Python library spaCy and what you can do with that (tokens, lemmas, part-of-speech tags, dependencies) 
  • how to process an entire text through a language model 
  • how to identify and count linguistic patterns (for example, adjectives describing characters, places, and buildings) 

Part B – Prompts in Text Analysis 

You will gain knowledge about: 

  • how you can use prompt engineering as a method in text analysis 
  • how to connect securely to the Mistral API (using environment variables for API keys rather than storing them in notebooks) 
  • the difference between user and system messages, as well as settings such as temperature and max tokens 
  • how to give the model specific analytical tasks (summaries, structured analysis, passage selection, sentiment analysis) 
  • how to save and critically evaluate the model’s responses (is the output grounded in the text and analytically useful?) 

By the end of the workshop, you will have been presented for methods to work with text analysis with pandas, with spaCy, and with LLM-based prompting, and you will have an idea about methods to apply in your future research.

description:
Vil du gerne analysere tekstmængder, der er så store, at du ikke selv kan nå at læse dem? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til begrebet text mining og viser eksempler på, hvordan det kan anvendes i praksis. På kurset tager vi udgangspunkt i et samling tekster, men de færdigheder, du lærer på kurset, kan anvendes på mange andre typer tekst.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkursus. På tekstanalysekurset har du dermed mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R.

Would you like to analyse volumes of text so large that you cannot read them yourself? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to the concept of text mining and demonstrates examples of how it can be applied in practice. The course is based on a collection of texts, but the skills you learn can be applied to many other types of text.

title: Harvest data from webpages without APIs - with R
description:
Websites contain a lot text and data. Some of them have API's for easy download of data, but many don't. In this course you will learn how to harvest various parts of webpages that don't have APIs. You will learn how to inspect a website and identify the parts of it that you want to harvest, whether it be numbers or text, and use R to transform it into a workable format. 

This is called web scraping. One of the advantages is that we can harvest data and text that is spread over many pages instead of having to copy-paste each page manually. In addition, we can ensure that it is in a format that allows us to work with page's content. In this course we will harvest both numbers in tables about the demographics of University of Copenhagen Students as well as text about a political and societal issue, both past and present

We assume that you have some experience working with R, and know the tidyverse. The level required is what you would learn on one of our introductory course in "R for absolute beginners". 

You are kindly asked to have R and Positron and the internet browser Firefox installed before the course. You can install R for Windows here and for Mac here. You can install Positron for Windows and Mac here. 

The course will be held in English if any participant requests it. If everyone speaks Danish it can be held in Danish

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 1
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

title: NVivo for absolutte begyndere - på dansk
description:
Please note that this course is in Danish. Introductory courses in English are on the 17th of September and the 29th of October.

Introduktion til NVivo - et program, der er en stor hjælp, når du arbejder med kvalitativ dataanalyse.

NVivo kan være nyttigt, hvis du vil organisere og/eller kode dit empiriske materiale eller litteratur. Det kan også være nyttigt, når du vil transskribere lyd- eller videofiler, generere hypoteser osv.

PC-versionen af NVivo har flere funktioner end Mac-versionen, men du kan deltage i alle øvelser med begge, og vi vil demonstrere i begge

Find kursuslokalet

Kurset bliver holdt på KUs Søndre Campus, Karen Blixens Plads 7, 2300 København S. •  Find vej  
Lokalet er på den 1.sal på biblioteket og hedder "Undervisningslokale 1".

 

Forberedelse før kurset

  1. Download de filer, vi skal bruge under kurset, og gem dem på din computer et sted, hvor du nemt kan finde dem. Du finder dem HERE. 
  2. Installer NVivo 15 - Du kan dog godt følg med i undervisning hvis du kun har adgang til NVivo 14. Tjek at du kan åbne programmet. For at tjekke at programmet fungerer som det skal, anbefaler vi at du gennemgå et tre indledende øvelser som findes i kursets Absalon rum: https://absalon.ku.dk/courses/88011

Da vi kun har begrænset tid til at nyde godt af hinandens selskab, er det vigtigt, at du inden kurset har installeret programmet. Det er ikke muligt at installere NVivo under kurset - det tager simpelthen for meget tid. 

 

Hvordan du installerer NVivo

Installationen kan være vanskelig. Læs instruktionerne nedenfor omhyggeligt og giv dig selv god tid til at installere programmet. Hvis du har problemer med at installere NVivo, er du meget velkommen til at kigge forbi biblioteket på Nørre Allé hver onsdag mellem 12:30 og 14:30. Forvent ikke, at vi har tid til at hjælpe med installationen under kurset.

Download NVivo for Windows:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15/NVivo.x64.exe

Download NVivo for Mac:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15forMac/NVivo.dmg

Du skal tilføje en registreringsnøgle (licensnøgle) for at aktivere programmet efter download. Nøglen er tilgængelig gennem KU's softwarebibliotek.  Når du er i Softwarebiblioteket, skal du klikke på "QSR International - NVivo" og acceptere betingelserne. Klik på "Licensnøgle" for at få licensnøglen og klik evt. på "Vejledning" for at downloade en PDF med installationsinstruktioner.

title: Introduktion til visualisering med ggplot2 i R / Introduction to visualising with ggplot2 in R
description:
Visualisering kan bruges til at finde mønstre i dine data, ligesom det kan bruges til at fortælle en overbevisende historie om dine resultater.
Vi gennemgår det grundlæggende i ggplot2, herunder forskellige typer plots, skalaer og facettering.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette.

Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk

 

Visualisation can be used to identify patterns in your data, as well as to tell a compelling story about your results.

We cover the basics of ggplot2, including different types of plots, scales and faceting.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learnt, while further developing your knowledge and skills in R. A good way to prepare is therefore to attend one of our beginner courses.

You are expected to have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course, so that we do not have to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is generally taught in Danish, but if one or more participants request it, it will be held in English.
location_name: Library Lighthouse, zone 1, Library Lighthouse, zone 2

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 2
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: NVivo for Absolute Beginners
description:
Introduction to NVivo; a program which is a great help when you are working with qualitative data analysis.

NVivo can be useful, if you want to organise and/or code your empirical material or literature. It can also be helpful when you want to transcribe audio- or video files, generate hypotheses etc.

The PC version of NVivo has more functionality than the Mac version, but you can participate in all exercises with either and we will demonstrate in both.

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: Dyk ned i data med R / Dive into data with R
description:
Har du en god basisforståelse af R, og vil du prøve at bruge teknikkerne på et større datasæt?

På kurset udforsker vi et større datasæt ud fra input fra deltagerne. Afhængig af ønskerne når vi ofte omkring emner som simple statistiske metoder og visualiseringer, arbejde med udvalgte dele af data og indlæsning og kombination af flere Excel-ark.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk. 

 

Do you have a solid basic understanding of R, and would you like to try applying these techniques to a larger dataset?

During the course, we explore a larger dataset based on input from the participants. Depending on preferences, we often cover topics such as simple statistical methods and visualisations, working with selected subsets of data, and importing and combining multiple Excel sheets.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: Python for not quite Absolute Beginners : sets, dictionaries, functions & libraries
description:
In the Python for not quite Absolute Beginners courses, we expand on previous learning to write more structured and reliable programs. Before you attend these courses, make sure you have completed Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 and 2 or are familiar with its topics.

In this part, you will learn how to use sets and dictionaries to store and manage data more effectively, write your own functions to organise your code and make it reusable, and to import libraries to extend your programs with additional tools and functionality.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

description:
Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

title: Lær at analysere tekster med R / Learn to analyse texts with R
description:
Vil du gerne analysere tekstmængder, der er så store, at du ikke selv kan nå at læse dem? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til begrebet text mining og viser eksempler på, hvordan det kan anvendes i praksis. På kurset tager vi udgangspunkt i et samling tekster, men de færdigheder, du lærer på kurset, kan anvendes på mange andre typer tekst.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkursus. På tekstanalysekurset har du dermed mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

 

Would you like to analyse volumes of text so large that you cannot read them yourself? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to the concept of text mining and demonstrates examples of how it can be applied in practice. The course is based on a collection of texts, but the skills you learn can be applied to many other types of text.

The course builds on our beginner course. In this text analysis course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: NVivo - Cases and Classification in Interview Data
description:
This course is not an introductory course but presupposes a basic understanding of the functionality in NVivo.
This understanding can be gained by participating in our introductory NVivo courses found here:
https://kubkalender.kb.dk/datalab

In this course, we will expand upon the skills gained in our introductory course (https://absalon.ku.dk/courses/88011), and we will be applying cases and case classification to qualitative data.

We will base the course examples on interview data, but both cases and case classifications can be applied to many other types of data.

The PC version of NVivo has more functionality than the Mac version, but you can participate in all exercises with either and we will demonstrate in both.

 

Prior to the course, you must install the version of NVivo called NVivo 15 on your laptop.

description:

title: Åbent værksted i Labbet / drop in consultations at KUB Datalab
description:
Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: Introduktion til visualisering med ggplot2 i R / Introduction to visualising with ggplot2 in R
description:
Visualisering kan bruges til at finde mønstre i dine data, ligesom det kan bruges til at fortælle en overbevisende historie om dine resultater.
Vi gennemgår det grundlæggende i ggplot2, herunder forskellige typer plots, skalaer og facettering.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette.

Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk

 

Visualisation can be used to identify patterns in your data, as well as to tell a compelling story about your results.

We cover the basics of ggplot2, including different types of plots, scales and faceting.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learnt, while further developing your knowledge and skills in R. A good way to prepare is therefore to attend one of our beginner courses.

You are expected to have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course, so that we do not have to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is generally taught in Danish, but if one or more participants request it, it will be held in English.
location_name: Library Lighthouse, Zone 1, Library Lighthouse, Zone 2

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

title: Python for absolutte nybegyndere del 1 (dansk)
description:
Dette kursus er for studerende, der aldrig har programmeret før og gerne vil lære Python helt fra bunden.

Virker matematik, tal og kryptiske Python-scripts lidt intimiderende? Bare rolig! Vi gennemgår alle de grundlæggende begreber og byggesten trin for trin, så du kan komme godt i gang med Python - også selvom du aldrig har skrevet kode før.

Du bliver blandt andet introduceret til variabler og datatyper og lærer at skrive simple scripts, der arbejder med data gennem eksempelvis lister, løkker og betingelser. Når kurset er slut, vil du have en grundlæggende forståelse for, hvordan Python fungerer, og hvordan et computerprogram “tænker”. Det eneste, vi forventer af dig, er lysten til at lære. Vi glæder os til at se dig!

Kurset er opdelt i to dele. I første del ser vi på forskellige datatyper i Python og på, hvordan data gemmes og håndteres. Det fungerer som en introduktion til de mest grundlæggende elementer i Python-programmering.

I anden del bygger vi videre på det grundlæggende og sammensætter byggestenene til små scripts. Hvis du allerede har lidt erfaring med Python, kan du sagtens springe første del over. Ellers anbefaler vi, at du starter med del 1 og derefter fortsætter med del 2.

 

Praktisk information: Vi arbejder i Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, som kræver en mindre installation. Du kan dog også vælge at arbejde i Google Colab eller ERDA, som kun kræver henholdsvis en Google-konto eller en KU-konto. Du kan finde mere information og hjælp under “Install & Run Python” på kursussiden:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: NVivo for absolutte begyndere - på dansk
description:
Introduktion til programmet NVivo, som er en stor hjælp til kvalitativ dataanalyse. NVivo kan bl.a. hjælpe dig med at organisere og kode din empiri og litteratur, generere hypoteser, transskribere din lyd/video og meget andet.

PC-versionen af NVivo har mere udvidet funktionalitet end Mac-versionen, men man kan deltage i alle øvelser uanset version, og undervisningen vil ligeledes blive demonstreret i begge.

 

Du bedes forud for kurset have installeret den version af NVivo, der hedder NVivo 15.

Det kan du gøre her til Windows:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15/NVivo.x64.exe

Og her til Mac:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15forMac/NVivo.dmg

Benyt derefter registreringsnøgle fra KU’s Softwarebibliotek.

Bemærk: NVivo findes i Sofwarebiblioteket under linket "QSR International - NVivo".

Du bedes ligeledes forud for kurset gennemgå et par introducerende øvelser, som du kan læse om her:
https://absalon.ku.dk/courses/88011

 

Gennemføres ved min. seks tilmeldte.

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 1
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html
location_name: Library Lighthouse, zone 1, Library Lighthouse, zone 2

Dette kursus er for studerende, der aldrig har programmeret før og gerne vil lære Python helt fra bunden.

Virker matematik, tal og kryptiske Python-scripts lidt intimiderende? Bare rolig! Vi gennemgår alle de grundlæggende begreber og byggesten trin for trin, så du kan komme godt i gang med Python - også selvom du aldrig har skrevet kode før.

Du bliver blandt andet introduceret til variabler og datatyper og lærer at skrive simple scripts, der arbejder med data gennem eksempelvis lister, løkker og betingelser. Når kurset er slut, vil du have en grundlæggende forståelse for, hvordan Python fungerer, og hvordan et computerprogram “tænker”. Det eneste, vi forventer af dig, er lysten til at lære. Vi glæder os til at se dig!

Kurset er opdelt i to dele. I første del ser vi på forskellige datatyper i Python og på, hvordan data gemmes og håndteres. Det fungerer som en introduktion til de mest grundlæggende elementer i Python-programmering.

I anden del bygger vi videre på det grundlæggende og sammensætter byggestenene til små scripts. Hvis du allerede har lidt erfaring med Python, kan du sagtens springe første del over. Ellers anbefaler vi, at du starter med del 1 og derefter fortsætter med del 2.

 

Praktisk information: Vi arbejder i Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, som kræver en mindre installation. Du kan dog også vælge at arbejde i Google Colab eller ERDA, som kun kræver henholdsvis en Google-konto eller en KU-konto. Du kan finde mere information og hjælp under “Install & Run Python” på kursussiden:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: Dyk ned i data med R / Dive into data with R - ONLINE
description:
Har du en god basisforståelse af R, og vil du prøve at bruge teknikkerne på et større datasæt?

På kurset udforsker vi et større datasæt ud fra input fra deltagerne. Afhængig af ønskerne når vi ofte omkring emner som simple statistiske metoder og visualiseringer, arbejde med udvalgte dele af data og indlæsning og kombination af flere Excel-ark.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk. 

 

Do you have a solid basic understanding of R, and would you like to try applying these techniques to a larger dataset?

During the course, we explore a larger dataset based on input from the participants. Depending on preferences, we often cover topics such as simple statistical methods and visualisations, working with selected subsets of data, and importing and combining multiple Excel sheets.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: NVivo for Absolute Beginners
description:
Introduction to NVivo; a program which is a great help when you are working with qualitative data analysis.

NVivo can be useful, if you want to organise and/or code your empirical material or literature. It can also be helpful when you want to transcribe audio- or video files, generate hypotheses etc.

The PC version of NVivo has more functionality than the Mac version, but you can participate in all exercises with either and we will demonstrate in both.

 

Prior to the course, you must install the version of NVivo called NVivo 15 on your laptop.

You can do that here for Windows:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15/NVivo.x64.exe

And here for Mac:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15forMac/NVivo.dmg

After download, use the registration key available through the UCPH Software Library. (The key can be found under the linke "QSR International - NVivo".)

In case of any difficulties in this process, please contact Copenhagen University’s Service desk.

 

We also recommend that you complete a set of introductory exercises before course start, that you can read about HERE.

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 2
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: NVivo - Cases and Classification in Interview Data
description:
This course is not an introductory course but presupposes a basic understanding of the functionality in NVivo.
This understanding can be gained by participating in our introductory NVivo courses found here:
https://kubkalender.kb.dk/datalab

In this course, we will expand upon the skills gained in our introductory course (https://absalon.ku.dk/courses/88011), and we will be applying cases and case classification to qualitative data.

We will base the course examples on interview data, but both cases and case classifications can be applied to many other types of data.

The PC version of NVivo has more functionality than the Mac version, but you can participate in all exercises with either and we will demonstrate in both.

 

Prior to the course, you must install the version of NVivo called NVivo 15 on your laptop.

You can do that here for Windows:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15/NVivo.x64.exe

And here for Mac:
https://download.qsrinternational.com/Software/NVivo15forMac/NVivo.dmg

After download, use the registration key available through the UCPH Software Library. (The key can be found under the linke "QSR International - NVivo".)

In case of any difficulties in this process, please contact Copenhagen University’s Service desk.

title: Åbent værksted i Labbet / drop in consultations at KUB Datalab
description:
Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

title: Lær at analysere tekster med R / Learn to analyse texts with R
description:
Vil du gerne analysere tekstmængder, der er så store, at du ikke selv kan nå at læse dem? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til begrebet text mining og viser eksempler på, hvordan det kan anvendes i praksis. På kurset tager vi udgangspunkt i et samling tekster, men de færdigheder, du lærer på kurset, kan anvendes på mange andre typer tekst.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkursus. På tekstanalysekurset har du dermed mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

 

Would you like to analyse volumes of text so large that you cannot read them yourself? Then this course may be for you. title: R og API – Danmarks statistik / R and API – Statistics Denmark - ONLINE
description:
Lær hvordan du automatisk kan trække data fra online kilder ved hjælp af R. Vi gennemgår de grundlæggende principper i de to typiske måder at lade dit R script tale sammen med online databaser, bl.a. Danmarks Statistik. 

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi kan nå så langt som muligt på kurset. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her. 

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.
 
Learn how to automatically extract data from online sources using R. We cover the basic principles in the two major ways of getting your R script to communicate with online databases, including Statistics Denmark. 

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we can make as much progress as possible. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes.

It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.  This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

description:
This course is part of our Python Summer School. We will offer courses throughout the week from August 10–14.
You can sign up for one course or as many as you like.

Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 & 2 are our core courses. After completing these (or if you already have Python knowledge equivalent to the course material), you can join all other Python courses in our Summer School.

You can find all of our course materials here: https://kubdatalab.github.io/python

And sign up for more courses here: https://kubkalender.kb.dk/calendar/datalab

---

In the Python for not quite Absolute Beginners courses, we expand on previous learning to write more structured and reliable programs. Before you attend these courses, make sure you have completed Python for Absolute Beginners Part 1 and 2 or are familiar with its topics.

In this part, you will learn how to import, analyse, and visualise data using the library pandas.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: Lær at lave statistiske analyser med R / Learn to perform statistical analyses with R
description:
Vil du gerne lære, hvordan man kan foretage statistiske analyser ved hjælp af R? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til, hvordan man kan lave statistiske analyser i R. På kurset vil emner som deskriptiv statistik, normalfordeling og regression blive berørt.

Dette er ikke et statistikkursus, så et basalt kendskab til statistiske begreber forudsættes.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På statistikkurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi kan nå så langt som muligt på kurset. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

Would you like to learn how to carry out statistical analyses using R? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to how statistical analyses can be conducted in R. Topics covered include descriptive statistics, the normal distribution, and regression.

This is not a statistics course, so a basic understanding of statistical concepts is required.

The course builds on our beginner courses. In this statistics course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we can make as much progress as possible. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: R for absolutte nybegyndere
description:
R er et programmeringssprog, som oprindeligt blev udviklet til statistiske analyser men i dag bruges til mange forskellige formål. Derfor kan det både bruges til analyser af tal og tekst.

Dette kursus er en grundlæggende introduktion til R. Der kræves ingen erfaring med programmering for at kunne deltage.

En forudsætning for at kunne foretage analyser i R, er at man har en grundlæggende forståelse for både programmeringssprog og grænseflade. Netop dette kan man lære på vores intro-kursus.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Please note: this course will be held in Danish. As part of our summer school, this course is also offered in English. Read more and sign up here.

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: Lær at analysere tekster med R / Learn to analyse texts with R
description:
Vil du gerne analysere tekstmængder, der er så store, at du ikke selv kan nå at læse dem? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til begrebet text mining og viser eksempler på, hvordan det kan anvendes i praksis. På kurset tager vi udgangspunkt i et samling tekster, men de færdigheder, du lærer på kurset, kan anvendes på mange andre typer tekst.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkursus. På tekstanalysekurset har du dermed mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

 

Would you like to analyse volumes of text so large that you cannot read them yourself? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to the concept of text mining and demonstrates examples of how it can be applied in practice. The course is based on a collection of texts, but the skills you learn can be applied to many other types of text.

The course builds on our beginner course. In this text analysis course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: Introduktion til visualisering med ggplot2 i R / Introduction to visualising with ggplot2 in R
description:
Visualisering kan bruges til at finde mønstre i dine data, ligesom det kan bruges til at fortælle en overbevisende historie om dine resultater.
Vi gennemgår det grundlæggende i ggplot2, herunder forskellige typer plots, skalaer og facettering.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette.

Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk

 

Visualisation can be used to identify patterns in your data, as well as to tell a compelling story about your results.

We cover the basics of ggplot2, including different types of plots, scales and faceting.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learnt, while further developing your knowledge and skills in R. A good way to prepare is therefore to attend one of our beginner courses.

You are expected to have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course, so that we do not have to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is generally taught in Danish, but if one or more participants request it, it will be held in English.

R er et programmeringssprog, som oprindeligt blev udviklet til statistiske analyser men i dag bruges til mange forskellige formål. Derfor kan det både bruges til analyser af tal og tekst.

Dette kursus er en grundlæggende introduktion til R. Der kræves ingen erfaring med programmering for at kunne deltage.

En forudsætning for at kunne foretage analyser i R, er at man har en grundlæggende forståelse for både programmeringssprog og grænseflade. Netop dette kan man lære på vores intro-kursus.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Please note: this course will be held in Danish. As part of our summer school, this course is also offered in English. Read more and sign up here.

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 2
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: Åbent værksted i Labbet / drop in consultations at KUB Datalab
description:
Having problems importing data? Or cleaning it? Is the structure weird, or are you getting strange error messages when you try to fit a model?

Drop in with your data and your problem, and we will do our best to help you. We offer no opinions on what statistical test you should run on your data. But we will get it to work. 

No registration required, we try to assist everyone, but if necessary on a "first-come, first-served" basis
presenter: Søren Davidsen, Henrik Hornemann & Christian Knudsen

This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: R for absolutte nybegyndere
description:
R er et programmeringssprog, som oprindeligt blev udviklet til statistiske analyser men i dag bruges til mange forskellige formål. Derfor kan det både bruges til analyser af tal og tekst.

Dette kursus er en grundlæggende introduktion til R. Der kræves ingen erfaring med programmering for at kunne deltage.

En forudsætning for at kunne foretage analyser i R, er at man har en grundlæggende forståelse for både programmeringssprog og grænseflade. Netop dette kan man lære på vores intro-kursus.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Please note: this course will be held in Danish. As part of our summer school, this course is also offered in English. Read more and sign up here.

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 1
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:
https://kubdatalab.github.io/python/docs/howto/setup.html

title: Python for Absolute Beginners pt. 2
description:
This course is intended for students who have never tried programming before and want to build their skills in Python from the bottom up.

Intimidated by mathematics, numbers, and obscure Python scripts? Don’t be! We will be covering all the very basic concepts and building blocks in order to get complete beginners, who have no experience writing code, working in Python.

This will include explaining the concepts of variables and data types, as well generating some basic scripts to interact with these data, such as lists, loops, and conditionals. By the end of this course, you will have an understanding of the basic building blocks in Python. You will also come away with an appreciation for how a computer program “thinks”. All we require from you is a will to learn. We look forward to seeing you!

The course is divided in two parts. The first covers different datatypes in Python and how data is stored. In other words, it is an introduction to the building blocks of coding in Python.

The second part expands on this by putting these blocks together to create simple scripts. If you already have some understanding of Python, feel free to skip the first section. Otherwise, we recommend that you start with pt. 1 and then move on to pt. 2.

 

Practical information: We will be working in Jupyter Lab / Jupyter Notebook, which requires some installation, but you can also work in either Google Colabs or ERDA which require only a Google or KU account, respectively. For more information and help, consult "Install & Run Python" on the course page:

title: R for Absolute Beginners
description:
R is a programming language that was originally developed for statistical analysis, but today it is used for a wide range of purposes. It can be used for analysing both numerical data and text.

This course is a basic introduction to R. No prior programming experience is required to participate.

A prerequisite for carrying out analyses in R is having a basic understanding of both the programming language and the interface. This is precisely what you will learn in our introductory course.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

title: Dyk ned i data med R / Dive into data with R
description:
Har du en god basisforståelse af R, og vil du prøve at bruge teknikkerne på et større datasæt?

På kurset udforsker vi et større datasæt ud fra input fra deltagerne. Afhængig af ønskerne når vi ofte omkring emner som simple statistiske metoder og visualiseringer, arbejde med udvalgte dele af data og indlæsning og kombination af flere Excel-ark.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk. 

 

Do you have a solid basic understanding of R, and would you like to try applying these techniques to a larger dataset?

During the course, we explore a larger dataset based on input from the participants. Depending on preferences, we often cover topics such as simple statistical methods and visualisations, working with selected subsets of data, and importing and combining multiple Excel sheets.

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: Lær at analysere tekster med R / Learn to analyse texts with R
description:
Vil du gerne analysere tekstmængder, der er så store, at du ikke selv kan nå at læse dem? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til begrebet text mining og viser eksempler på, hvordan det kan anvendes i praksis. På kurset tager vi udgangspunkt i et samling tekster, men de færdigheder, du lærer på kurset, kan anvendes på mange andre typer tekst.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkursus. På tekstanalysekurset har du dermed mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

 

Would you like to analyse volumes of text so large that you cannot read them yourself? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to the concept of text mining and demonstrates examples of how it can be applied in practice. The course is based on a collection of texts, but the skills you learn can be applied to many other types of text.

The course builds on our beginner course. In this text analysis course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we do not need to spend time on this. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: NVivo - Cases and Classification in Interview Data
description:
This course is not an introductory course but presupposes a basic understanding of the functionality in NVivo.
This understanding can be gained by participating in our introductory NVivo courses found here:
https://kubkalender.kb.dk/datalab

In this course, we will expand upon the skills gained in our introductory course (https://absalon.ku.dk/courses/88011), and we will be applying cases and case classification to qualitative data.

title: R for absolutte nybegyndere
description:
R er et programmeringssprog, som oprindeligt blev udviklet til statistiske analyser men i dag bruges til mange forskellige formål. Derfor kan det både bruges til analyser af tal og tekst.

Dette kursus er en grundlæggende introduktion til R. Der kræves ingen erfaring med programmering for at kunne deltage.

En forudsætning for at kunne foretage analyser i R, er at man har en grundlæggende forståelse for både programmeringssprog og grænseflade. Netop dette kan man lære på vores intro-kursus.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi ikke skal bruge tid på dette. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Please note: this course will be held in Danish. As part of our summer school, this course is also offered in English. Read more and sign up here.

title: R og API – Danmarks statistik / R and API – Statistics Denmark - ONLINE
description:
Lær hvordan du automatisk kan trække data fra online kilder ved hjælp af R. Vi gennemgår de grundlæggende principper i de to typiske måder at lade dit R script tale sammen med online databaser, bl.a. Danmarks Statistik. 

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På kurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi kan nå så langt som muligt på kurset. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her. 

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.
 
Learn how to automatically extract data from online sources using R. We cover the basic principles in the two major ways of getting your R script to communicate with online databases, including Statistics Denmark. 

The course builds on our beginner courses. You will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we can make as much progress as possible. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

title: Lær at lave statistiske analyser med R / Learn to perform statistical analyses with R
description:
Vil du gerne lære, hvordan man kan foretage statistiske analyser ved hjælp af R? Så er dette kursus måske noget for dig. Kurset giver en introduktion til, hvordan man kan lave statistiske analyser i R. På kurset vil emner som deskriptiv statistik, normalfordeling og regression blive berørt.

Dette er ikke et statistikkursus, så et basalt kendskab til statistiske begreber forudsættes.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På statistikkurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi kan nå så langt som muligt på kurset. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

Would you like to learn how to carry out statistical analyses using R? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to how statistical analyses can be conducted in R. Topics covered include descriptive statistics, the normal distribution, and regression.

This is not a statistics course, so a basic understanding of statistical concepts is required.

The course builds on our beginner courses. In this statistics course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.

It is assumed that you have installed R and Positron/RStudio before the course so that we can make as much progress as possible. You can find help with installing R and Positron/RStudio here.

The course is primarily conducted in Danish, but if one or more participants prefer, it can be delivered in English.

Kurset ligger i forlængelse af vores begynderkurser. På statistikkurset har du således mulighed for at anvende de ting, du allerede har lært, samtidig med at du udbygger din viden og dine færdigheder i R. Derfor kan en god forberedelse være at deltage i et vores begynderkurser.

Det forudsættes at du har installeret R og Positron/RStudio før kurset, sådan at vi kan nå så langt som muligt på kurset. Du kan finde hjælp til at installere R og Positron/RStudio her.

Kurset er som udgangspunkt på dansk, men hvis en eller flere deltagere ønsker det, afholdes det på engelsk.

Would you like to learn how to carry out statistical analyses using R? Then this course may be for you. The course provides an introduction to how statistical analyses can be conducted in R. Topics covered include descriptive statistics, the normal distribution, and regression.

This is not a statistics course, so a basic understanding of statistical concepts is required.

The course builds on our beginner courses. In this statistics course, you will therefore have the opportunity to apply what you have already learned while expanding your knowledge and skills in R. As preparation, it may be beneficial to attend one of our beginner courses.
